_comment: PROPOSAL, not policy. Adds one artifact rule so the gate can inspect Argus-Setup.exe. It cannot loosen anything: the global deny lists (suffixes, path parts, markers, bytecode magic) still apply to every member. Needs the same two-person review as a change to release/policy.json before it is merged into it. Until then a tagged release build refuses Argus-Setup.exe (deny by default); only release-test/* dry runs load this file. The allow list is the member list 7z shows for an NSIS installer built by release/build_windows.py: tune it against the first dry run's report, never widen it to patterns that admit source.
